FX-SHCLIP-001.says: A file written before D-563, without the three settings, at Shadow/Highlight's starting settings: drawn exactly as FX-SHHI-001.

FX-SHCLIP-002.says: The three written at 0: the same as FX-SHCLIP-001.

FX-SHCLIP-003.says: Midtone contrast 50 after the starting shadow lift: lightnesses above the middle lighter, below it darker; black and white stay.

FX-SHCLIP-005.says: Midtone contrast -50: the middle tones drawn together toward the middle.

FX-SHCLIP-007.says: Midtone contrast 60 with both amounts 0: it works alone, with no lift.

FX-SHCLIP-008.says: Black clip 20: the darkest fifth of the picture pushed to black.

FX-SHCLIP-009.says: White clip 10: the lightest tenth pushed to white.

FX-SHCLIP-010.says: Black clip 15 and white clip 15 together: both ends.

FX-SHCLIP-011.says: Both clips 12 with both amounts 0: the drawing stretched by its own count alone.

FX-SHCLIP-012.says: Both clips 0.01, After Effects' starting numbers as recalled: the drawing's own black and white are more than 0.01 per cent of it, so nothing is clipped and it is drawn as FX-SHCLIP-001.

FX-SHCLIP-013.says: Shadow 70, highlight 30, midtone contrast 40, both clips 10: every step in turn.

FX-SHCLIP-014.says: Midtone contrast keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 as FX-SHCLIP-006, frame 2 as FX-SHCLIP-002, frame 4 as FX-SHCLIP-004.

FX-SHCLIP-015.says: Black clip keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 as FX-SHCLIP-002, frame 2 as FX-SHCLIP-008, frame 4 further.

FX-SHCLIP-016.says: FX-SHCLIP-013 moved three pixels right: the count is of the whole layer, so the same, moved.

FX-SHCLIP-017.says: Both clips 50: the black bin is at or above the white bin, so the clips do nothing and it is drawn as FX-SHCLIP-001.

FX-SHCLIP-018.says: Midtone contrast 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHCLIP-019.says: Midtone contrast -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHCLIP-021.says: White clip 51, above 50. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
